Hi all,

  please review this fix that avoids some UD loading unintialized data (but not dereferencing it) with -XX:-UsePerfData in TraceCollectorStats::TraceCollectorStats (via G1MonitoringScope).

The fix is to always properly initialize the members of some CollectorCounter classes.

Also adding some cleanup in G1MonitoringScope (that is never reached by current code).

Testing: gha
